[0] Apple made history in 2022 when its film *CODA* won the Academy Award for Best Picture. Now, the next project from that film's director, *Being Heumann*, has finally secured a release date on Apple TV+.

[1] *Being Heumann*, from the director of *CODA*, is set to debut on Apple TV+ this November.

[2] Apple's film division has had its fair share of highs and lows — but *CODA* remains a standout success.

[3] *CODA* won Best Picture at the Oscars in 2022, along with two other Academy Awards. Its victory made Apple TV+ the first streaming platform ever to take home the top film honor at the Oscars.

[4] Now, the next film from *CODA* director Sian Heder is nearing completion and is once again being distributed by Apple.

[5] *Being Heumann* will begin a limited theatrical run on November 6, before landing on Apple TV+ on November 13.

[7] *Entertainment Weekly* broke the exclusive news on the new film, including several insights from Heder about the project.

[8] *Being Heumann*, along with the previously announced *Tenzing*, are already being tipped as early Oscar contenders.

[9] These titles are expected to complement several of Apple's more crowd-pleasing films, including this week's pickleball comedy *The Dink*.

[10] What do you think of Apple's upcoming film slate? Share your thoughts in the comments.

[11] Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or you can save with a bundle through Apple One.
